title: Bears score 59 points in Season 2026 opener, fourth-most in franchise history
dek: Chicago defeated Carolina 59-37 in Week 1, combining for 96 points, the most ever in an NFL season opener. D'Andre Swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns. The offensive eruption validates Ben Johnson's preseason goal to build the highest-scoring unit in NFL history, but the defense allowed 478 yards and six rushing touchdowns.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Chicago Bears 59, Carolina Panthers 37; 96 combined points set NFL season-opener record.
bottom_line: The 59-point ceiling proves Johnson's system can produce historic offensive volume. The vulnerability is whether Chicago's defense can hold up in games where opponents score below 37, or whether dominant scoring becomes the only pathway to wins.
body: Chicago's offense produced 552 yards and five touchdown scorers in a 59-37 rout of Carolina on the road, combining with the Panthers for 96 points, per ESPN's reporting, the most ever in an NFL season opener. The 59-point total ranks fourth in Bears franchise history.

The eruption validates offensive coordinator Ben Johnson's preseason pledge to construct the highest-scoring unit in NFL history. Johnson cited the 2013 Denver Broncos' single-season record of 37.9 points per game as his benchmark, according to ESPN.

D'Andre Swift led the ground attack with 124 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries. Kyle Monangai added 100 yards and a touchdown. Caleb Williams completed 21 of 29 passes for 269 yards and two scores, and also rushed for a touchdown in his first career game with multiple rushing scores, including a 29-yard scramble into the end zone before halftime. Five different Bears players reached the end zone.

The defensive showing, however, exposed vulnerabilities that will resurface in closer contests. Carolina rushed for 291 yards and six touchdowns on 39 carries, and the Panthers accumulated 478 total yards, per ESPN. Cornerback Jaylon Johnson stated post-game the defense cannot bank on the offense scoring 60 points weekly: "I think for us, we're not going to--at least on defense--expect them to score 60 points a game. We got to figure out ways to do our part." Chicago also committed 12 penalties and fumbled on its opening drive, drawing four flags in the first five minutes.

Quarterback Bryce Young threw for 361 yards, three touchdowns and one interception for Carolina. Rookie nickel back Malik Muhammad intercepted Young before halftime. The Panthers, who mustered the sixth-fewest points in the NFL last season according to ESPN, mounted a 37-point response despite Carolina's defense receiving major investments: defensive end Jaelan Phillips signed a four-year, $120 million deal and linebacker Devin Lloyd a three-year, $42 million contract. Panthers head coach Dave Canales deferred judgment on defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero's future until reviewing film, per ESPN.

Bears averaged 5.5 points in second quarters last season, ranking 26th in the league. The offensive firepower on display pulled off seven fourth-quarter comebacks in 2025 and now must sustain the production as the schedule tightens.
